workflow: A build-time helper initializes runtime configuration and allocates nested strings, lists, and registration metadata.
The helper exits through cleanup that releases the outer configuration object but omits allocations owned by its nested fields.
Leak-detection instrumentation scans the remaining allocations at process exit and classifies them as leaks.
The helper exits unsuccessfully, causing the build to fail even though the generation operation itself completed.
summary: Incomplete configuration cleanup triggers sanitizer-reported leaks during build-time execution
